---- MODULE W4Od16m0p6t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Rx, Techs, NONE, MaxVer, MaxTries
ASSUME NONE \notin Rx

VARIABLES ver, hold, snap, dispensed, cver, tries

TypeOK ==
    /\ ver \in [Rx -> 0..MaxVer]
    /\ hold \in [Techs -> Rx \cup {NONE}]
    /\ snap \in [Techs -> 0..MaxVer]
    /\ dispensed \subseteq Rx
    /\ cver \in [Rx -> -1..MaxVer]
    /\ tries \in [Techs -> 0..MaxTries]

Init ==
    /\ ver = [r \in Rx |-> 0]
    /\ hold = [t \in Techs |-> NONE]
    /\ snap = [t \in Techs |-> 0]
    /\ dispensed = {}
    /\ cver = [r \in Rx |-> -1]
    /\ tries = [t \in Techs |-> 0]

Read(t, r) ==
    /\ hold[t] = NONE
    /\ r \notin dispensed
    /\ hold' = [hold EXCEPT ![t] = r]
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![t] = ver[r]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, dispensed, cver, tries>>

Amend(r) ==
    /\ r \notin dispensed
    /\ ver[r] < MaxVer
    /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![r] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<hold, snap, dispensed, cver, tries>>

Commit(t) ==
    /\ hold[t] # NONE
    /\ LET r == hold[t] IN
        /\ snap[t] = ver[r]
        /\ r \notin dispensed
        /\ dispensed' = dispensed \cup {r}
        /\ cver' = [cver EXCEPT ![r] = snap[t]]
        /\ hold' = [hold EXCEPT ![t] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, snap, tries>>

Retry(t) ==
    /\ hold[t] # NONE
    /\ snap[t] # ver[hold[t]]
    /\ tries' = [tries EXCEPT ![t] = IF @ < MaxTries THEN @ + 1 ELSE @]
    /\ hold' = [hold EXCEPT ![t] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, snap, dispensed, cver>>

Recall(r) ==
    /\ r \in dispensed
    /\ dispensed' = dispensed \ {r}
    /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![r] = 0]
    /\ cver' = [cver EXCEPT ![r] = -1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<hold, snap, tries>>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Techs, r \in Rx : Read(t, r)
    \/ \E r \in Rx : Amend(r)
    \/ \E t \in Techs : Commit(t)
    \/ \E t \in Techs : Retry(t)
    \/ \E r \in Rx : Recall(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<ver, hold, snap, dispensed, cver, tries>>

NoStaleDispense ==
    \A r \in dispensed : cver[r] = ver[r]
====

---- MODULE W4Od15m0p0t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Traders, NONE, MaxGen
ASSUME NONE \notin Traders

VARIABLES lock, gen, snap, trying, held

TypeOK ==
    /\ lock \in Traders \cup {NONE}
    /\ gen \in 0..MaxGen
    /\ snap \in [Traders -> 0..MaxGen]
    /\ trying \in [Traders -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ held \in [Traders -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
    /\ lock = NONE
    /\ gen = 0
    /\ snap = [t \in Traders |-> 0]
    /\ trying = [t \in Traders |-> FALSE]
    /\ held = [t \in Traders |-> FALSE]

Bump == IF gen < MaxGen THEN gen + 1 ELSE gen

Read(t) ==
    /\ ~trying[t]
    /\ ~held[t]
    /\ trying' = [trying EXCEPT ![t] = TRUE]
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![t] = gen]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, gen, held>>

Acquire(t) ==
    /\ trying[t]
    /\ lock = NONE
    /\ snap[t] = gen
    /\ lock' = t
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![t] = TRUE]
    /\ trying' = [trying EXCEPT ![t] = FALSE]
    /\ gen' = Bump
    /\ UNCHANGED snap

Fail(t) ==
    /\ trying[t]
    /\ (lock # NONE \/ snap[t] # gen)
    /\ trying' = [trying EXCEPT ![t] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, gen, snap, held>>

Release(t) ==
    /\ held[t]
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![t] = FALSE]
    /\ lock' = NONE
    /\ gen' = Bump
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, trying>>

AdminSeize(t) ==
    /\ lock # t
    /\ lock' = t
    /\ held' = [x \in Traders |-> x = t]
    /\ trying' = [trying EXCEPT ![t] = FALSE]
    /\ gen' = Bump
    /\ UNCHANGED snap

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Traders : Read(t)
    \/ \E t \in Traders : Acquire(t)
    \/ \E t \in Traders : Fail(t)
    \/ \E t \in Traders : Release(t)
    \/ \E t \in Traders : AdminSeize(t)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<lock, gen, snap, trying, held>>

    \A a, b \in Traders : (held[a] /\ held[b]) => a = b

Conflict(i) ==
    /\ busy[i]
    /\ rdver[i] # ver

    /\ log' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED <<qlen, rdver, busy>>

    \/ \E i \in Insts : Take(i)

CONSTANTS Feeders, Slots, NONE, Total
ASSUME Feeders = {1, 2, 3}

RECURSIVE SumOver(_, _)
SumOver(S, f) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + SumOver(S \ {x}, f)

VARIABLES token, load, msg, delivered

TypeOK ==
    /\ token \in Feeders
    /\ load \in [Feeders -> 0..Total]
    /\ msg \in [Slots -> Feeders \cup {NONE}]
    /\ delivered \in 0..Total

Init ==
    /\ token = 1
    /\ load = [f \in Feeders |-> IF f = 1 THEN Total ELSE 0]
    /\ msg = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ delivered = 0

Succ(n) == CASE n = 1 -> 2 [] n = 2 -> 3 [] OTHER -> 1

Occ == Cardinality({s \in Slots : msg[s] # NONE})

    /\ token = f
    /\ token' = Succ(f)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, msg, delivered>>

Shed(f, g, s) ==
    /\ token = f
    /\ load[f] > 0
    /\ msg[s] = NONE
    /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![f] = @ - 1]
    /\ msg' = [msg EXCEPT ![s] = g]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, delivered>>

Redirect(s, g) ==
    /\ msg[s] # NONE
    /\ msg' = [msg EXCEPT ![s] = g]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, load, delivered>>

Deliver(s) ==
    /\ msg[s] # NONE
    /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![msg[s]] = @ + 1]
    /\ msg' = [msg EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
    /\ delivered' = IF delivered < Total THEN delivered + 1 ELSE delivered
    /\ UNCHANGED token

    \/ \E f, g \in Feeders, s \in Slots : Shed(f, g, s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots, g \in Feeders : Redirect(s, g)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Deliver(s)

SumOver(S, f) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + SumOver(S \ {x}, f)

VARIABLES pool, lobby, inflight, leaseEnd, clock

TypeOK ==
    /\ pool \in 0..N
    /\ lobby \in [Lobbies -> 0..N]
    /\ inflight \in [Slots -> Lobbies \cup {NONE}]
    /\ leaseEnd \in [Lobbies -> 0..MaxT]
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxT

    /\ pool = N
    /\ lobby = [l \in Lobbies |-> 0]
    /\ inflight = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ leaseEnd = [l \in Lobbies |-> 0]
    /\ clock = 0

Occ == Cardinality({s \in Slots : inflight[s] # NONE})

Assign(l, s) ==
    /\ pool > 0
    /\ inflight[s] = NONE
    /\ clock <= leaseEnd[l]
    /\ pool' = pool - 1
    /\ inflight' = [inflight EXCEPT ![s] = l]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lobby, leaseEnd, clock>>

Join(s) ==
    /\ inflight[s] # NONE
    /\ lobby' = [lobby EXCEPT ![inflight[s]] = @ + 1]
    /\ inflight' = [inflight EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, leaseEnd, clock>>

Renew(l) ==
    /\ leaseEnd' = [leaseEnd EXCEPT ![l] = IF clock + K <= MaxT THEN clock + K ELSE MaxT]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, lobby, inflight, clock>>

    /\ lobby[l] > 0
    /\ clock > leaseEnd[l]
    /\ lobby' = [lobby EXCEPT ![l] = @ - 1]
    /\ pool' = pool + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inflight, leaseEnd, clock>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxT
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, lobby, inflight, leaseEnd>>

    \/ \E l \in Lobbies, s \in Slots : Assign(l, s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Join(s)
    \/ \E l \in Lobbies : Renew(l)
    \/ \E l \in Lobbies : Leave(l)
    \/ Tick

Conserved == pool + SumOver(Lobbies, lobby) + Occ = N

    /\ voted \subseteq Blocks

    /\ cap \in 1..MaxV

Init ==

    /\ voted = {}

VoteNo(b) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ phase' = "aborting"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<voted, val, cap>>

Prepared ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ voted = Blocks
    /\ phase' = "committing"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<voted, val, cap>>

DoCommit ==
    /\ phase = "committing"
    /\ \A b \in Blocks : val[b] < cap
    /\ val' = [b \in Blocks |-> val[b] + 1]
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<voted, cap>>

DoAbort ==
    /\ phase \in {"aborting", "committing"}
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<voted, val, cap>>

SetCap(c) ==
    /\ cap' = c

    /\ val' = [b \in Blocks |-> 0]

    \/ \E b \in Blocks : VoteNo(b)
    \/ Prepared
    \/ DoCommit

    \/ \E c \in 1..MaxV : SetCap(c)
